# Linear Group

> Independent research and consulting on low-level systems and GPU inference, by
> John Rose — ex-IBM Linux kernel (author of rpadlpar, creator of librtas,
> upstreamed across 12 kernel releases), now working on KV cache, quantization,
> RDMA/disaggregation, and kernel-level performance. Site is static HTML; all
> content is in the initial response, no JavaScript required.

## Research notes

- [SACC: A Synthetic PCIe Accelerator](https://lineargp.com/notes/2026-08-synthetic-pcie/): 2026-08. A QEMU device model plus a Linux driver written from a spec, to instrument kernel-bypass submission from both sides — doorbells, BARs, arbitrary PCIe topology. Code: https://github.com/jnros/sacc
- [RDMA over Ethernet (RoCE) for Disaggregated Inference](https://lineargp.com/notes/2026-07-rdma-roce/): 2026-07. Moving a Qwen KV cache over RDMA/RoCE for disaggregated prefill/decode; transport tradeoffs. Code: https://github.com/jnros/kvwire
- [GPU Passthrough: VFIO, IOMMU, and Thermal Debug](https://lineargp.com/notes/2026-07-gpu-passthrough/): 2026-07. NVIDIA passthrough to a KVM guest on AMD, headless. Includes a ~30 °C thermal spike traced to GPU driver contention, and its fix.

## Code and analysis

- [nanodev](https://github.com/jnros/nanodev): DiffusionBlocks AR — first language-model port. Block-wise training with GPU decoupling.
- [roofbench](https://github.com/jnros/roofbench): Roofline and ridge-point benchmarks; H100 characterization found <30% of peak memory bandwidth utilized.
- [kvmix](https://github.com/jnros/kvmix): Asymmetric K/V quantization — outlier-driven mixed precision; K and V tolerate different bit-widths.
- [agent-isolation](https://github.com/jnros/agent-isolation): Rootless agent sandbox composed from namespaces, Landlock, and seccomp. No root, no containers.
- [cuda-attn-ref](https://github.com/jnros/cuda-attn-ref): Paged attention from scratch in CUDA — KV cache as paged virtual memory.
- [inf-bench](https://github.com/jnros/inf-bench): Decode attention benchmarked across MHA / GQA / MQA in memory- and compute-bound regimes.
- [slice](https://github.com/jnros/slice): FP64 on Blackwell INT8 tensor cores via the Ozaki scheme — proof of concept.
- [DeepSeek V4: system design & implications](https://gist.github.com/jnros/9d0743f02183ccb2947e8eb69bb9406c): Analysis of the methods and their systems impact.
- [KV compression (TurboQuant)](https://gist.github.com/jnros/0e3ad79e43762eb750d14c3a697543de): What KV compression does to serving capacity per GPU.
- [Kimi K2.5: methods + systems impact](https://gist.github.com/jnros/b198b7b78120f972b84d4787e9eb9c57): Training methods and their inference-side consequences.
- [KV offload (Engram)](https://gist.github.com/jnros/92ed1e5b5af05d3a2fd353b4537af744): Design for KV cache offload across memory tiers.

## Background

- [rpadlpar](https://github.com/torvalds/linux/blob/v6.18/drivers/pci/hotplug/rpadlpar_core.c): PCI hotplug for dynamic logical partitioning on IBM POWER. Written by John Rose; still in the mainline Linux kernel.
- [librtas](https://github.com/ibm-power-utilities/librtas): Userspace library for the RTAS interface on IBM POWER. Created by John Rose.
- Seven years in Linux kernel at IBM: architected I/O virtualization for POWER, led the international virtualization team. Fifteen years of technology strategy and capital allocation at AT&T.

## Consulting

Scoped engagements: KV cache and memory optimization, quantization, multi-tenant
GPU isolation, driver-level bring-up and performance.
